example_prompt: List the identity documents Smile ID can verify for a country (e.g. country_code=SN) to build a document picker before Document Verification.

continent.description: Filter results to a single continent. Query parameter.

country_code.description:
Filter results to a single country. Must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
(two uppercase letters). Query parameter.

locale.description:
Locale for document names. Defaults to `en-GB`.
Supported values: `en-GB`, `fr-FR`, `ar-EG`. Query parameter.

name.description: Human-readable name of the ID type.

has_back.description: Whether this document type has a back side that should be captured.

gotchas: No authentication required: this endpoint is public.
Errors use a different shape from the rest of the V3 API: { error, code } instead of { status, message }.
Filter with country_code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase) or continent; locale (en-GB, fr-FR, ar-EG) only changes the document names. has_back tells you whether to capture the back of the document.
Enhanced Document Verification only offers the ID types enabled on your account, not this full public catalog.
Sandbox base URL is https://testapi.smileidentity.com (this spec uses production, https://api.smileidentity.com).

spans: This endpoint does not require authentication.
